Run the review now.","tool_calls":[{"index":0,"id":"call_00_QpMLvKfLNMLYHPtu8BvQ5199","type":"function","function":{"name":"zts_expert_review_patch","arguments":"{"file": "handler.ts", "content": "import { schemaCompile, validateJson } from \"zttp:validate\";\n\nschemaCompile(\"item\", JSON.stringify({\n  type: \"object\",\n  required: [\"name\"],\n  properties: {\n    name: { type: \"string\" }\n  }\n}));\n\nexport function handler(req: Request): Proof<Response,\n  | \"deterministic\"\n  | \"state_isolated\"\n  | \"fault_covered\"\n  | \"result_safe\"\n  | \"optional_safe\"\n  | \"no_secret_leakage\"\n  | \"no_credential_leakage\"\n  | \"input_validated\"\n  | \"pii_contained\"\n  | \"injection_safe\"\n  | \"canonical\"\n  | \"cost_bounded\"\n> {\n  const raw = requestText(req);\n  if (!raw.ok) {\n    return Response.json({ errors: raw.error }, { status: 400 });\n  }\n  const checked = validateJson(\"item\", raw.value);\n  if (!checked.ok) {\n    return Response.json({ errors: checked.error }, { status: 400 });\n  }\n  return Response.json(checked.value);\n}\n"}"}}]},"logprobs":null,"finish_reason":"tool_calls"}],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":18153,"completion_tokens":1512,"total_tokens":19665,"prompt_tokens_details":{"cached_tokens":15488},"completion_tokens_details":{"reasoning_tokens":1158},"prompt_cache_hit_tokens":15488,"prompt_cache_miss_tokens":2665},"system_fingerprint":"a26a7955944dc5c60445bff77fac9c8e"}
